_comment: This file is a configuration-only Python module (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines model settings for an MMSegmentation EncoderDecoder with ResNetV1c-50 backbone, JPU neck, PSPHead decode head, and FCNHead auxiliary head for 19-class semantic segmentation.
summarize_model_config: summarize the fastfcn_r50-d32_jpu_psp model configuration including backbone neck and head settings
review_model_config: review the fastfcn_r50-d32_jpu_psp configuration for correctness of norm_cfg and loss settings
build_segmentation_model: build an MMSegmentation EncoderDecoder model using the fastfcn_r50-d32_jpu_psp config dictionary
test_model_config: test the fastfcn_r50-d32_jpu_psp config by instantiating the EncoderDecoder model and verifying layer shapes
refactor_model_config: refactor the fastfcn_r50-d32_jpu_psp config to change num_classes or backbone depth
